The ACS Foundation is looking for a part-time 15-month intern who is currently studying to join their team based in Sydney CBD. The successful intern will be a part of organising and running the BiG Day In, a national ICT Careers Conference designed to inform, inspire and encourage high school and university students to pursue a career in technology, and the BiG Day In Junior, days consisting of 3-5 workshops held by ICT-related companies to educate and inspire students in Years 5 and 6 about the possibilities of a career in STEM.

A successful candidate will have the flexibility to travel nationally for the BiG Day In events in Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Brisbane, Sunshine Coast, Newcastle, Hobart, Canberra, Adelaide, Darwin & Perth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Co-ordinate, manage and co-host the BiG Day In events;
* Design and develop digital campaigns – graphic designs for event posters, floor banners, and other ad-hoc design duties
* Collaborate with co-hosts from host venues;
* Liaise with and manage crew members/ volunteers;
* Create and organize slide decks and scripts;
* Occasional outbound calling to high schools.

**Requirements:**

* Excellent written and spoken English;
* Outstanding organisational skills, be able to work autonomously and to deadlines;
* An eye for detail
* Comfortable working with the Adobe Creative Cloud (particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and occasionally Lightroom) & Microsoft Office Suite;
* Flexibility to work a minimum of 2 full days a week (ideally a minimum of 3 full days a week from March – June) and travel interstate;
* Interest in the IT industry is desirable.

**Qualifications:**

* Must be enrolled in their second year or above of study in an undergraduate degree at an Australian University.
* Must be a current students and studying throughout 2027.

**Benefits:**

* Interstate travel for BiG Day In;
* Flexibility to work around your university timetable;
* May qualify if you need internship placement hours for your degree.

The opportunity to meet and network with large ICT companies like Adobe, Microsoft, TechnologyOne, BHP, WiseTech Global, and many more.

**Things to note:**

Training for this role will commence asap, to train you must be able to work at least either Monday or Wednesday for the duration of 2027.

Interstate travel is required for this role. The ideal candidate must be able to put most, if not all, of their subjects on Mondays or Fridays (as most BiG Day In events and the required travelling will be on Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday).

Public speaking is a large part of this role. The successful candidate should be comfortable being on stage to MC events and speak in front of large crowds.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.

**About the role**

Our Forward Deployed team works between our customers and our product. They take a customer’s whole support operation (the tickets, the systems, the policies) and turn it into AI agents that resolve real customer queries in production.

As an FDE intern, you’ll be part of that team from day one, not on a side project. The workflows you build will go live and handle real conversations for some of the largest fintech and healthtech companies in the US and Australia. You’ll have close support from the team and real ownership of the work you take on.

Day to day, you’ll:

* Dig into customers’ support tickets and data to find where AI can fully resolve queries, and where it can’t yet
* Build, test, and refine AI workflows from first draft through to production
* Help connect workflows to customer systems through APIs, and test integrations before they go live
* Join customer calls, share what you’ve found, and own defined parts of an implementation
* Use Claude Code and other AI tools to speed up analysis, build internal tooling, and improve how the team works

You’ll leave knowing how AI agents are deployed end to end at scale in regulated industries. You’ll also have hands-on skills in workflow design, API integrations, testing and evaluation, and LLM fundamentals, and experience turning a customer’s messy real-world problem into a working solution.

**We’d love to talk if you**

* Are curious and learn fast. You pick up new tools quickly and enjoy figuring things out.
* Are technically confident. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you’re comfortable reading API docs and working with data.
* Sweat the details. You notice when something’s off, ask good questions, and follow through.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people alike.
* Are genuinely interested in AI. It’s a bonus if you’ve experimented with LLMs or built something with AI tools on your own.

**We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too.** Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

**Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii.** Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

**A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops.** We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. **Required Qualifications**

Do you love working with children aged 3 to 5 years and helping them build confidence, independence and school readiness through play-based learning?

As our Pre K Team Leader, you will create a safe, welcoming and nurturing environment where children can develop friendships, explore their interests and feel confident participating in daily routines and play.

* Cert III working towards Diploma

* Experience leading a group of children and supporting other educators.

If you are a motivated and caring Diploma qualified educator ready to lead our Pre K program, we would love to hear from you.

**About the team**

**The National Measurement Institute**  
  
We are the Australian Government’s national authority on measurement.  
  
At the National Measurement Institute (NMI), we empower innovation and protect trust in Australian industry and society through world-class measurement science. Join a team where your expertise drives national impact, your curiosity is nurtured, and the work you do creates trusted measurement for a fair, safe, healthy, and competitive Australia. **Physical Metrology Branch**  
  
NMI’s Physical Metrology Branch provides Australia’s peak measurement standards for physical quantities. This enables measurements made in Australia to be accepted internationally, which is particularly important for trade. Our people share their expertise by providing measurement services from calibration and testing to technical advice and training. We contribute actively to international measurement forums and enhance our capabilities through research and development in line with national and international requirements.  
  
**Power Systems Technology Team**  
  
NMI's Power Systems Technology team develops advanced measurement technologies and delivers specialist testing and calibration services that support Australia's electricity network and clean energy transition. The team operates Australia's largest high-voltage and high-current laboratory and provides critical services to electric power utilities, equipment manufacturers and industry stakeholders. Supporting Australia's Net Zero ambitions, our work underpins the generation, storage, transmission and use of clean energy. Its capabilities span three key areas: high-voltage testing and calibration, calibration of power system voltage and current sensors, and the design and manufacture of highly accurate digital and analogue measurement systems.  
  
The team delivers more than 30 specialised testing and calibration services across a diverse range of power system equipment and measurement parameters. It also undertakes applied research in collaboration with universities, national metrology institutes and industry partners to develop innovative measurement techniques and technologies. Our team's experts contribute to the development of Australian and international standards through active participation in Standards Australia and the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). We provide technical leadership across a range of national and international working groups, helping shape the future of power system measurement science and engineering.

**Job Description**

  

*This is a* *12-month fixed term contract role.*

  

As senior marketing manager, tax and accounting, you are accountable for marketing across TR’s Tax and Accounting Professionals (TAAP) portfolio in ANZ: Checkpoint, Checkpoint World and the ESG reporting solution. You own the marketing plan and lead its delivery: generating pipeline for a sales-led business, growing and retaining the customer base, and building the market presence of TR’s tax and accounting brands. The role is roughly 30% strategy and planning and 70% hands-on execution: you design the plan and set the standard for the portfolio, and do most of the work yourself.

  

The portfolio serves accountants and tax professionals across ANZ and, through Checkpoint World, international tax specialists in markets outside the US. Much of the growth opportunity sits with existing and lapsed customers, and with new sustainability reporting requirements that are creating demand for the ESG solution.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

In this opportunity as a Senior Marketing Manager, Tax and Accounting- ANZ, you will:

* **Own the TAAP marketing plan:** create and deliver the integrated marketing plan for the TAAP portfolio in ANZ, aligned to business targets and agreed with the TAAP leadership team, covering priorities, budget, calendar and measures.

* **Drive pipeline and revenue growth:** deliver marketing’s contribution to TAAP targets through qualified leads, sourced and influenced pipeline, and wins, across ANZ and the international markets served by Checkpoint World.

* **Plan and run integrated campaigns:** lead always-on and launch campaigns end to end across email and marketing automation, digital, webinars, events and content, building audiences with Marketing Operations and doing much of the execution yourself.

* **Lead go-to-market for launches:** translate global product positioning and assets into regional launch plans, sales tools and customer communications, so new products and capabilities reach the right audiences and sales are ready at launch.

* **Grow and retain the customer base:** develop marketing to existing and lapsed customers, covering adoption, upgrade, renewal and win-back, with Customer Growth and Retention, and turn customer results into proof for future campaigns.

* **Set the standard for content and copy:** own the quality and consistency of TAAP marketing content, writing and editing priority material, reviewing and challenging what the business produces, and directing writers, designers and agencies.

* **Manage the digital and web presence:** own TAAP content across TR’s websites and digital channels, so it reflects the strength of the portfolio’s content brands, stays current, and performs in search and conversion, working with TR’s web and digital teams.

* **Measure, report and improve:** track and report marketing performance against agreed targets, and use testing, data and customer insight to improve results over time.

* **Partner with sales and the business:** act as the marketing partner to the TAAP leadership team and sales, aligning on targets, lead management and follow-up, equipping sales with messaging and materials, and building marketing capability across the business.

  

**Required Qualifications**

You’re a fit for the role of Senior Marketing Manager, Tax and Accounting- ANZ, if you have the following required qualifications:

* **Marketing planning:** You have built a marketing plan for a business or portfolio from a low base, set the priorities and budget, and gained agreement from senior stakeholders.
* **Integrated campaigns:** You have planned and run integrated B2B campaigns yourself, targeting prospects and existing customers (including upgrade or win-back campaigns), that generated pipeline for a sales team and delivered measurable results.

* **Content and copy:** You are a strong writer and editor, with the judgement to improve weak content and to brief writers and designers to a high standard.
* **Marketing technology and digital:** You do the work yourself in marketing automation, CRM, web content management, and digital channels, rather than only briefing others.
* **Measurement:** You use data to track pipeline from lead to win and to decide what to scale, fix, or stop, including running simple tests.
* **Sales and stakeholder partnership:** You have the confidence to tell senior stakeholders when work is not good enough, and the credibility to work as a peer to sales without formal authority.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience marketing to accountants, tax advisers or other professional services firms, and knowledge of the Australian tax and accounting market, its professional bodies and events.

* Familiarity with ESG or sustainability reporting.

* Experience running webinars and events that produced pipeline, with follow-up agreed with sales.

* Experience building audiences and working with marketing operations on data, lead routing and consent.
